answer: A new key must lock a work-bond and finish four uniquely attested tasks across four epochs, with at least six hours between submissions, before that bond may sit on the emission terrace. Until then, weight stays at zero. A nightly clustering pass joins keys that share RPC fingerprints, payee graphs, or inter-arrival jitter under 40 seconds; if the group collapses into one crystal of common infrastructure, every unvested bond is slashed and the cluster keeps a single identity cap. Honest labor remains, like a quartz vein, slow to grow and expensive to forge at farm scale.
